summary: todo-app set up: project created with 5 tasks (spec, build, tests, review, preview)

actions.name: Team to-do app
actions.description: Simple bilingual (Arabic RTL / English) to-do web app for the team. React, tasks saved in the browser, no login or server.
actions.businessRequirements: Add a task with title and optional due date; mark done; edit; delete; filter All/Active/Done; count of tasks left; Arabic (RTL) + English with a language switch; light and dark mode; works well on iPhone.
actions.technicalRequirements: Vite + React + TypeScript; localStorage; static build served at /agency-projects/todo-app/; Vitest + Testing Library; GitHub Actions CI; $0.
actions.scope: In: the features above. Out: accounts, sync between devices, server, notifications.

actions.title: One-page spec with user stories
acceptanceCriteria: User stories with Given/When/Then for every requested feature

actions.title: Build the web app (Vite + React + TS)

acceptanceCriteria: A Vitest + Testing Library test per acceptance criterion
.github/workflows/todo-app.yml path-filtered, runs npm ci, npm test, npm run build:preview
